## Read the raw data

Read from `../data/raw/`.

```{r reading in raw data}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)

mlb_stats = readr::read_csv(
  "../data/raw/baseball_reference_raw.csv"
)

hitting_raw = readRDS(
  "../data/raw/mlb_api_hitting_raw.rds"
)

abs_raw = readr::read_csv(
  "../data/raw/abs_challenges_raw.csv"
)

people_data = readRDS(
  "../data/raw/mlb_people_raw.rds"
)
```
## Clean each source

## Cleaning and Transformation

The raw datasets contain different column names, formats, and levels of detail. The data was cleaned by standardizing column names, selecting relevant variables, creating consistent player identifiers, and preparing the datasets for merging.

The player name matching key was converted to lowercase and stripped of leading and trailing spaces to improve consistency across sources.

## Save the cleaned data

Write to `../data/processed/`.

```{r cleaning the MLB stats data}
mlb_clean = mlb_stats |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_name = Player,
    team_name = Team,
    games = G,
    at_bats = AB,
    hits = H,
    home_runs = HR,
    walks = BB,
    strikeouts = SO,
    avg = BA,
    obp = OBP,
    slg = SLG,
    ops = OPS,
    year = year
  )

head(mlb_clean)

dplyr::glimpse(mlb_clean)
```

```{r clean api data}
hitting_clean = hitting_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player$id),
    player_name = player$fullName,
    plate_appearances = stat$plateAppearances,
    avg = stat$avg,
    obp = stat$obp,
    slg = stat$slg,
    ops = stat$ops,
    home_runs = stat$homeRuns,
    walks = stat$baseOnBalls,
    strikeouts = stat$strikeOuts
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name,
    plate_appearances,
    avg,
    obp,
    slg,
    ops,
    home_runs,
    walks,
    strikeouts,
    year
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player_name))
  )

head(hitting_clean)
dplyr::glimpse(hitting_clean)
```

```{r abs clean}
abs_clean = abs_raw |>
  dplyr::select(
    entity_name,
    runs_above_average,
    runs_gained,
    runs_cost,
    n_challenges,
    n_overturns,
    n_confirms,
    rate_overturns,
    n_strikeouts_flip,
    n_walks_flip
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    player = entity_name,
    runs_above_avg = runs_above_average,
    challenges = n_challenges,
    challenge_wins = n_overturns,
    challenge_losses = n_confirms,
    win_percentage = rate_overturns,
    strikeouts_removed = n_strikeouts_flip,
    walks_gained = n_walks_flip
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player))
  )

head(abs_clean)
names(abs_clean)
summary(abs_clean)
```

```{r clean player height}
player_height = people_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id = id,
    player_name = fullName,
    height
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id),
    height_clean = gsub("[^0-9 ]", "", height)
  )

player_height$height_inches = sapply(
  strsplit(trimws(player_height$height_clean), " +"),
  function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) * 12 + as.numeric(x[2])
)

player_height = player_height |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name,
    height,
    height_inches
  )

head(player_height)
```

```{r write cleaned data to processed}
readr::write_csv(
  mlb_clean,
  "../data/processed/baseball_reference_clean.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  hitting_clean,
  "../data/processed/mlb_api_hitting_clean.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  abs_clean,
  "../data/processed/abs_challenges_clean.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  player_height,
  "../data/processed/player_height_clean.csv"
)
```

```{r}
clean_step1 = final_data_all_years |>
  dplyr::group_by(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_2tm = any(team_name == "2TM")
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !has_2tm | team_name == "2TM"
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-has_2tm)
```

```{r}
clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::count(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

dim(clean_step1)

clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::count(year)
```

```{r}
class(clean_step1$ops.x)
class(clean_step1$ops.y)

head(clean_step1$ops.x)
head(clean_step1$ops.y)

clean_step1$ops.x <- as.numeric(clean_step1$ops.x)
clean_step1$avg.x <-as.numeric(clean_step1$avg.x)
clean_step1$obp.x <- as.numeric(clean_step1$obp.x)
clean_step1$slg.x <- as.numeric(clean_step1$slg.x)
```

```{r}
ops_check = clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_difference = abs(avg.x - avg.y),
    obp_difference = abs(obp.x - obp.y),
    slg_difference = abs(slg.x - slg.y),
    ops_difference = abs(ops.x - ops.y)
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_avg_difference = max(avg_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_obp_difference = max(obp_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_slg_difference = max(slg_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ops_difference = max(ops_difference, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ops_check
```

```{r}
clean_data = clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name = player_name.x,
    player_key,
    year,
    team = team_name,
    plate_appearances,
    games,
    at_bats,
    hits,
    avg = avg.x,
    obp = obp.x,
    slg = slg.x,
    ops = ops.x,
    home_runs = home_runs.x,
    walks = walks.x,
    strikeouts = strikeouts.x,
    runs_above_avg,
    runs_gained,
    runs_cost,
    challenges,
    challenge_wins,
    challenge_losses,
    win_percentage,
    strikeouts_removed,
    walks_gained
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    abs_data_matched = !is.na(challenges),
    period = ifelse(year < 2026, "Pre-ABS", "ABS-era")
  )

dim(clean_data)
names(clean_data)
head(clean_data)
```

```{r}
# Check for duplicate column names
anyDuplicated(names(clean_data))

# Check for duplicate player-season records
clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(clean_data))

# Check for negative batting or challenge counts
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    plate_appearances < 0 |
    games < 0 |
    at_bats < 0 |
    hits < 0 |
    home_runs < 0 |
    walks < 0 |
    strikeouts < 0 |
    challenges < 0
  )

# Check challenge wins and losses
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(challenges)) |>
  dplyr::filter(challenge_wins + challenge_losses != challenges)

# Check win percentages
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(win_percentage)) |>
  dplyr::filter(win_percentage < 0 | win_percentage > 1)

# Check season totals
clean_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    players = dplyr::n(),
    average_PA = mean(plate_appearances),
    average_OPS = mean(ops)
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr2)

abs_data = read_csv("../data/abs_clean_validated.csv")

names(abs_data)
dim(abs_data)
```

```{r}
player_ids = unique(abs_data$player_id)

player_ids = player_ids[!is.na(player_ids)]

length(player_ids)
```

```{r}
people_url = "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people"

people_parts = list()

for (i in seq(1, length(player_ids), by = 50)) {

  ids_chunk = player_ids[i:min(i + 49, length(player_ids))]

  people_raw = request(people_url) |>
    req_url_query(
      personIds = paste(ids_chunk, collapse = ",")
    ) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_string() |>
    fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

  people_parts[[length(people_parts) + 1]] = people_raw$people
}

people_data = bind_rows(people_parts)

names(people_data)
```

```{r}
player_height = people_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id = id,
    player_name = fullName,
    height
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id),
    height_clean = gsub("[^0-9 ]", "", height)
  )

player_height$height_inches = sapply(
  strsplit(trimws(player_height$height_clean), " +"),
  function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) * 12 + as.numeric(x[2])
)

player_height = player_height |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name,
    height,
    height_inches
  )

head(player_height)
```

```{r}
dim(player_height)

sum(is.na(player_height$player_id))
sum(is.na(player_height$height))
sum(is.na(player_height$height_inches))

player_height |>
  count(player_id) |>
  filter(n > 1)

player_height |>
  filter(height_inches < 60 | height_inches > 90)

player_height |>
  arrange(height_inches)
```

```{r}
abs_data = abs_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id)
  )
player_height = player_height |>
  dplyr::select(player_id, height, height_inches)

abs_data = abs_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(player_height, by = "player_id")
```

```{r}
height_groups = abs_data |>
  dplyr::select(player_id, height_inches.x) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(height_inches.x)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    height_group = ntile(height_inches.x, 3)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    height_group = case_when(
      height_group == 1 ~ "Shortest Third",
      height_group == 2 ~ "Middle Third",
      height_group == 3 ~ "Tallest Third"
    )
  ) |>
  select(player_id, height_group)
```

```{r}
abs_data = abs_data |>
  left_join(height_groups, by = "player_id")
```

```{r}
dim(abs_data)

abs_data |>
  dplyr::count(year)

abs_data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_records = dplyr::n(),
    missing_heights = sum(is.na(height_inches.x)),
    missing_height_groups = sum(is.na(height_group))
  )

abs_data |>
  dplyr::count(player_id, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

abs_data |>
  dplyr::count(height_group, year)
```

```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  abs_data,
  "../data/abs_clean_validated_with_height.csv"
)
```
